thread:
elaine (secops): Heads-up: starting RBAC hardening for inference namespaces tomorrow. Goal: remove any service accounts with cluster-admin and set automountServiceAccountToken=false by default. Please run the audit and fix critical findings within 5 days.

tom (eng-platform): Short instructions: run infra/tools/rbac-audit and upload the report to the ticket. We'll warn for 48h then auto-apply safe changes.

yasmin (eng-sre): Note: we'll run a canary in staging first and the controller will only warn there. Expect a scoreboard tile in Console showing findings.

ci-bot: [scan] staging-canary: 3 findings -> 1 critical (sa: inference-processor -> cluster-admin).

ryan (eng-runtime): If any runtime images rely on automount, use the init-sidecar from infra/tools to bootstrap tokens. Link in the README.

elaine (secops): Exceptions: open ticket `rbac-exempt: <team>` with justification + ETA. Exceptions auto-expire after 14 days. Non-compliance may temporarily throttle workloads.

tom (eng-platform): If CI breaks, ping me and we'll flip `rbac.grace=true` in test clusters for 48h.

elaine (secops): Thanks — will follow up with email to Dedicated customers and a separate private-deploy guide.
